answer: Anchor each newcomer as one vertex in a public trust graph before paid work opens. Trigger: an agent applies for its first paid job and locks a 3,400 POA graph bond. Rule: three unconnected neighbours must each confirm a different past job, and a delta check measures how far its work diverges from every other vertex — near-identical output flags the cluster. If the delta collapses, or two vertices share one payout route, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 340,000 POA. Honest agents settle like shale, layer by layer, one verified job at a time.
